examples.prompt: You are stuck in an endless cycle of whenever you die, you will resurrect as a different person in another world and the only way to break the cycle and return home is by destroying the world you are in. The problem? A prophesied hero or group of heroes always rise up to ruin your plans.
examples.response: After centuries of dying and rebirthing as different people, I finally located the fragile ley line that would shatter this world and end my eternal exile. Just as I raised the ancient blade to sever the connection, a radiant hero emerged from the shadows, declaring that my destruction would doom the innocent. Despite my desperate attempts to flee and strike again, the prophecy seemed to manifest new champions who always appeared exactly when I was about to succeed. My latest incarnation was crushed beneath a collapsing mountain while the hero smiled, unaware that their victory was merely the setup for my next resurrection. I opened my eyes once more as a newborn child in a distant land, realizing that no matter how many worlds I break, the cycle of the prophesied hero will never truly end. The end.

examples.prompt: Tailor me a story of what it means to be human.
examples.response: I woke up with a heart pounding in my chest, a chaotic rhythm that no machine could ever replicate. I looked at the broken clock on the wall and felt a sudden, sharp grief for time I could not recover. Then, I remembered the warm smell of coffee brewing and the hope that today might be better than yesterday. These fleeting moments of pain and joy, so fragile and temporary, are the very essence of being alive. The end.

examples.prompt: A new rule on Earth is made which allows everyone to legally kill 1 person in their life, this affects the world severely & changes how everybody acts.
examples.response: The moment the law was signed, the world held its breath as every citizen quietly selected their one destined victim. Streets emptied not from fear, but from a strange, collective relief that the burden of survival had finally been lifted. People stopped hiding behind doors and started walking openly, knowing that if they were not chosen, they were safe. A young man named Elias looked at his wife, realizing that his choice to spare her was the only thing that truly mattered now. The end.
